news.titleEn: Surging Treasury yields don't signal a U.S. 'fiscal apocalypse' — yet
news.conclusionEn: U.S. Treasury yields have climbed to their highest levels since 2002, with the 10-year firmly above 5%, reviving fears of a debt spiral.
news.conclusionZh: 美债收益率升至2002年以来最高，10年期稳居5%以上
news.whyEn: Higher government borrowing costs ripple into mortgages, corporate loans and stock valuations worldwide, and raise the U.S. interest bill sharply.
news.whyZh: 美债利率是全球资产定价之锚，房贷、企业融资和股市估值都会受压
news.detailEn: TD Securities estimates U.S. net interest costs at about $1.1 trillion in fiscal 2026, rising to $1.6 trillion by 2029 if yields stay here. Budget hawks warn of a self-reinforcing cycle where interest begets more debt and still higher yields. Strategists counter that a resilient economy, high oil prices and a hawkish Fed are also driving the move, and that the debt is refinanced gradually. The Fed's September meeting minutes, due Wednesday, are the next test for bonds.
news.detailZh: TD证券估计美国2026财年净利息支出约1.1万亿美元，若利率维持当前水平，2029年将升至1.6万亿。财政鹰派警告利息推高债务、债务再推高利率的恶性循环。也有分析师认为，经济韧性、高油价和美联储偏鹰同样在推高收益率，且债务是逐步再融资的，危机尚未迫在眉睫。周三公布的美联储9月会议纪要是债市下一个关键看点。

news.titleEn: Stock futures are little changed after Nasdaq hits new record: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: The Nasdaq Composite rose about 1% to a record close on Monday as AI-linked tech stocks rallied despite multi-decade-high Treasury yields.
news.conclusionZh: AI科技股领涨，纳指周一涨约1%创收盘新高
news.whyEn: Gains are increasingly concentrated in mega-cap tech: equal-weight indexes and the Dow are well below their highs, signaling a narrow, fragile rally.
news.whyZh: 涨势高度集中于科技巨头，等权指数和道指仍远离高点，行情偏窄
news.detailEn: The Nasdaq is now up about 18% year to date, while the equal-weight S&P 500 ETF is 5.5% below its peak and the Dow is down 6.3% from its high. SpaceX jumped nearly 8%, lifting Elon Musk back to trillionaire status, after Musk confirmed talks with TSMC about the Terafab chip venture. Schneider Electric's $22.6 billion bid for PTC and a Brazil rally also moved stocks. Investors are watching whether tech can keep shrugging off rising borrowing costs.
news.detailZh: 纳指年内累计上涨约18%，而标普500等权ETF较高点仍低5.5%，道指较高点回落6.3%。马斯克确认与台积电就Terafab芯片项目进行洽谈后，SpaceX股价大涨近8%，马斯克身家重回万亿美元。施耐德电气收购PTC以及巴西股市大涨也是当天焦点。市场关注科技股能否继续无视利率上升。

news.titleEn: Saudi Aramco chief says replenishing global oil stockpiles could take two years
news.conclusionEn: Aramco CEO Amin Nasser warned that rebuilding global oil inventories could take up to two years, even after the Strait of Hormuz fully reopens.
news.conclusionZh: 阿美CEO称全球原油库存恢复或需长达两年
news.whyEn: A prolonged supply squeeze keeps oil near $100 a barrel, feeding inflation and pressuring central banks and fuel-importing economies.
news.whyZh: 供应紧张延续将令油价维持高位，推高通胀，压制进口国经济
news.detailEn: Nasser said nearly 3 billion barrels of supply have been lost since the U.S.-Iran war began, while about 1 billion barrels have been drawn from stocks. Speaking in London, he said pressure would intensify until Hormuz fully reopens and confidence returns. Oil prices edged lower Monday as exports through Hormuz and Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline recovered. The G7 agreed last week to release 100 million barrels from emergency reserves.
news.detailZh: 纳赛尔表示，美伊战争爆发以来全球已损失近30亿桶原油供应，约10亿桶靠动用库存弥补。他在伦敦称，在霍尔木兹海峡完全恢复通航、市场信心回归之前，压力只会加剧。周一油价小幅回落，因经霍尔木兹海峡和沙特东西管道的出口有所恢复。七国集团上周已同意释放1亿桶紧急储备。

news.titleEn: Brazilian stocks jump as Bolsonaro now seen as heavy favorite to win presidency
news.conclusionEn: Flávio Bolsonaro edged out President Lula by about 2 points in Brazil's first round, and markets now see him as the clear favorite in the Oct. 25 runoff.
news.conclusionZh: 巴西大选首轮小博索纳罗领先卢拉，股市大涨
news.whyEn: Investors view Bolsonaro as more market-friendly; Latin America's largest economy could see a sharp policy shift.
news.whyZh: 投资者视其为更亲市场，拉美最大经济体政策或大转向
news.detailEn: Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, outperformed polls that had expected him to trail Lula in the first round. Prediction markets lifted his odds of winning to over 80% from about 60%. The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF surged 13%, while U.S.-listed Itaú and Bradesco rose 16% and 19%. The runoff is set for October 25.
news.detailZh: 小博索纳罗是前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗之子，首轮表现好于民调预期（此前预计他会落后卢拉）。预测市场给出的胜选概率由约60%升至80%以上。iShares巴西ETF暴涨13%，在美上市的伊塔乌银行和布拉德斯科银行分别涨16%和19%。决选定于10月25日举行。

news.titleEn: French conglomerate Schneider Electric set to acquire Boston's PTC for $22.6 billion
news.conclusionEn: Schneider Electric agreed to buy industrial software maker PTC for $205 a share in cash, about $22.6 billion, a record deal for the French group.
news.conclusionZh: 施耐德电气拟以226亿美元现金收购PTC
news.whyEn: It is one of the year's biggest industrial-software deals, signaling a race to combine factory hardware with design and AI software.
news.whyZh: 年内最大工业软件并购之一，显示硬件巨头加速布局软件与AI
news.detailEn: The offer is a 42% premium to PTC's last close; PTC shares surged about 33% while Schneider's shares fell on the record price tag. PTC makes CAD and product-lifecycle software used by over 30,000 manufacturers. Schneider targets $250 million in annual cost savings and about $800 million in revenue synergies. The deal is expected to close by Q3 2027, pending approvals.
news.detailZh: 收购价较PTC前收盘价溢价约42%，PTC股价大涨约33%，施耐德股价则因收购价过高而下跌。PTC为3万多家制造企业提供CAD和产品生命周期管理软件。施耐德预计每年可节省2.5亿美元成本，并带来约8亿美元收入协同。交易尚需监管批准，预计2027年第三季度前完成。

news.titleEn: Trump's nemesis in Europe: Why Spain's Sanchez is calling a snap election
news.conclusionEn: Spanish PM Pedro Sánchez called a snap election for Nov. 29 after parliament rejected his housing reforms amid mass protests.
news.conclusionZh: 西班牙首相桑切斯宣布11月29日提前大选
news.whyEn: Polls suggest a right-wing coalition could win, which could reshape Spain's stance on trade with the U.S. and China and its clash with Trump.
news.whyZh: 右翼或上台，西班牙对美中贸易立场及与特朗普关系可能生变
news.detailEn: Parliament narrowly rejected measures to protect tenants and curb investor purchases of homes, confirming Sánchez had lost his majority. He is betting housing anger will mobilize left-leaning voters, while his party faces corruption cases and fallout from a migrant influx in Ceuta. Sánchez has been Europe's most vocal critic of the U.S. war with Iran, prompting Trump to threaten to cut off trade. The vote adds to Europe's crowded election calendar and fiscal uncertainty.
news.detailZh: 议会以微弱差距否决了保护租客、限制投资者购房的措施，证实桑切斯已失去多数。他押注住房危机引发的民怨能动员左翼选民，但其政党深陷腐败案，还面临休达移民潮的冲击。桑切斯是欧洲批评美伊战争最响亮的声音，特朗普曾威胁切断与西班牙的贸易。此次选举进一步加剧了欧洲的政治与财政不确定性。

news.titleEn: Pentagon stops using Anthropic AI tools after blacklisting company, BBC told
news.conclusionEn: A U.S. Defense Department official said the Pentagon has ceased using Anthropic's products, months after labeling the AI firm a supply-chain risk.
news.conclusionZh: 五角大楼证实已停用Anthropic的AI产品
news.whyEn: It marks a major escalation in the fight over AI safety guardrails and could shift lucrative government AI contracts to rivals.
news.whyZh: AI安全限制之争升级，政府AI大单或流向竞争对手
news.detailEn: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth designated Anthropic a national-security supply-chain risk in February after it refused to remove safeguards against mass surveillance and autonomous weapons. Sources told the BBC that Claude was still used as recently as last week for research, intelligence and operations against Iran. Anthropic declined to comment and is suing the administration to overturn the designation. The case is a test of how much control AI developers keep over military use of their models.
news.detailZh: 国防部长赫格塞思今年2月将Anthropic列为国家安全供应链风险，起因是该公司拒绝取消防止大规模监控和自主武器的安全限制。知情人士称，直到上周Claude仍被用于研究、情报及对伊朗的军事行动。Anthropic拒绝置评，并已起诉政府要求撤销该认定。此案考验AI公司对其模型军事用途能保留多大控制权。

news.titleEn: Zelensky condemns 'horrific' Russian strike on boat carrying corn in Black Sea
news.conclusionEn: A Russian drone strike sank a Turkish-owned ship carrying corn inside Romania's exclusive economic zone, killing two crew members.
news.conclusionZh: 俄无人机击沉黑海一艘土耳其运粮船，两人遇难
news.whyEn: Attacks near NATO member Romania threaten Black Sea grain exports and shipping insurance, raising global food-security risks.
news.whyZh: 袭击逼近北约成员国罗马尼亚，威胁黑海粮食出口和航运安全
news.detailEn: Romania said the vessel sank about 30 nautical miles south of its port of Sfântu Gheorghe; 11 crew from Azerbaijan and India were rescued. Russia's defense ministry said it had struck two cargo vessels, after vowing to intensify strikes in retaliation for Ukrainian attacks on its refineries. Zelensky called for international pressure to restore food security. Further incidents could push up grain prices and war-risk insurance premiums.
news.detailZh: 罗马尼亚称该船在其圣格奥尔基港以南约30海里处沉没，11名阿塞拜疆和印度籍船员获救。俄国防部称袭击了两艘货船，此前俄方扬言将加大打击力度，报复乌克兰袭击其炼油厂。泽连斯基呼吁国际社会施压以保障粮食安全。若事件持续，可能推高粮价和战争险保费。

news.titleEn: Yemeni military says it has retaken Mokha and 'secured' Red Sea waterway
news.conclusionEn: Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces claimed to have captured the Red Sea city of Mokha and secured the Bab al-Mandab Strait in a new offensive against the Houthis.
news.conclusionZh: 也门政府军称收复穆哈港，控制曼德海峡
news.whyEn: Bab al-Mandab is a key chokepoint for global trade and oil; control of it affects shipping costs and Red Sea security.
news.whyZh: 曼德海峡是全球贸易与石油要道，关乎航运成本与红海安全
news.detailEn: The government said operations had also begun on other fronts, including the capital Sanaa, held by the Houthis for 12 years. Some sources told Reuters and AFP that forces had only reached Mokha's outskirts, so claims remain contested. A Saudi-led coalition said it had hit 324 high-value targets, while the Houthis warned civilian airlines that Saudi airspace was no longer safe. Escalation could add to Middle East supply risks already lifting oil prices.
news.detailZh: 政府方面称包括首都萨那在内的其他战线也已开打，萨那已被胡塞武装控制12年。但有消息人士对路透社和法新社称部队仅抵达穆哈郊区，战果仍有争议。沙特领导的联军称已摧毁324个高价值目标，胡塞武装则警告民航沙特领空已不安全。局势升级可能进一步加剧中东供应风险，推高油价。

news.titleEn: 'Unwelcome and unsafe': Why Japanese companies are retreating from China at a historic rate
news.conclusionEn: The number of Japanese companies operating in China fell to a record low of 10,118, down 22% in two years, according to Teikoku Databank.
news.conclusionZh: 在华日企数量降至10118家，创有记录以来新低
news.whyEn: The exodus reshapes Asian supply chains and reflects deepening China-Japan tensions over Taiwan.
news.whyZh: 日企撤离重塑亚洲供应链，也反映中日因台湾问题关系恶化
news.detailEn: The tally is about 30% below the 2012 peak and the lowest since tracking began in 2010. Ties soured after PM Sanae Takaichi's November remarks on Taiwan, after which Beijing curbed critical-mineral exports to Japanese firms and discouraged travel to Japan. Rising costs, tariff risks and fierce local competition were already squeezing margins. Analysts expect the withdrawal to intensify, with some firms reducing reliance on China without fully exiting.
news.detailZh: 这一数字较2012年峰值低约30%，为2010年有统计以来最低。去年11月高市早苗首相发表涉台言论后，两国关系急转直下，中方限制对日企出口关键矿产并劝阻国民赴日旅游。成本上升、关税风险和本土竞争激烈早已挤压日企利润。分析师预计撤离潮将加剧，部分企业选择降低对华依赖而非完全退出。

businessTips.explanationEn: An acquisition premium is the extra amount a buyer pays above a target's market price, typically 20-50%. Buyers justify it with synergies: cost savings (merging overlapping functions) and revenue synergies (cross-selling to each other's customers). Cost synergies are usually more reliable than revenue synergies, which often fail to materialize. If the synergies are worth less than the premium, the buyer's shareholders lose value — which is why acquirers' stocks often fall on announcement.
businessTips.explanationZh: 收购溢价是买方在目标公司市价之上额外支付的部分，通常为20%至50%。买方用「协同效应」来证明溢价合理：成本协同（合并重叠部门省钱）和收入协同（向彼此客户交叉销售）。成本协同通常比收入协同可靠，后者经常落空。如果协同价值低于溢价，买方股东就会亏损，这也是收购方股价常在宣布当天下跌的原因。
businessTips.exampleEn: Schneider Electric is paying a 42% premium for PTC, citing $250 million in annual cost savings and about $800 million in revenue synergies. The market's skepticism showed immediately: PTC jumped 33% while Schneider's shares fell. When evaluating any deal, compare the premium paid with the realistic, mostly cost-based synergies.
businessTips.exampleZh: 施耐德电气以42%的溢价收购PTC，理由是每年2.5亿美元成本节约和约8亿美元收入协同。市场的怀疑立刻显现：PTC大涨33%，施耐德却下跌。评估任何并购时，都应把支付的溢价和现实可实现、以成本为主的协同效应放在一起比较。

businessTips.explanationEn: Upselling means offering a customer a higher-tier version of what they are already buying; cross-selling means offering a complementary product. Selling more to existing customers is far cheaper than acquiring new ones, since trust is already established. For small businesses and side hustles, a simple good-better-best pricing ladder plus one natural add-on can lift average order value significantly. The key is relevance — offers must genuinely help the customer, not feel pushy.
businessTips.explanationZh: 向上销售是向客户推荐他正在购买产品的更高档版本；交叉销售是推荐互补产品。向老客户多卖一点远比获取新客户便宜，因为信任已经建立。对小生意和副业来说，一个简单的「基础-进阶-高级」价格阶梯，加上一个顺理成章的附加品，就能明显提高客单价。关键是相关性：推荐必须真正帮到客户，而不是让人觉得被推销。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance resume writer sells a $99 resume, offers a $179 package that adds a LinkedIn profile rewrite (upsell), and suggests a $49 interview-prep call at checkout (cross-sell). If one in four buyers takes an add-on, revenue per client rises meaningfully with no extra marketing spend.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由职业简历写手卖99美元的简历服务，同时提供179美元套餐，加上领英资料改写（向上销售），结账时再推荐49美元的面试辅导通话（交叉销售）。只要四分之一的客户购买附加服务，单客收入就会明显提升，而且不用多花营销费用。

businessTips.explanationEn: Bond vigilantes are investors who sell government bonds to protest policies they see as fiscally irresponsible or inflationary, driving up borrowing costs. Higher yields act as market discipline, forcing governments to reconsider spending or deficits. The term was coined in the 1980s, and the effect famously forced the Clinton administration toward deficit reduction and toppled UK PM Liz Truss's budget in 2022. Watching whether yields rise on fiscal news, not just on growth or inflation data, helps spot vigilantes at work.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「债券义勇军」指那些通过抛售国债来抗议政府财政失控或通胀政策的投资者，他们推高政府的借贷成本。高收益率相当于市场纪律，迫使政府重新考虑支出和赤字。这一说法源于1980年代，曾迫使克林顿政府转向削减赤字，也在2022年让英国首相特拉斯的预算方案崩盘。观察收益率是否在财政消息（而不仅是增长或通胀数据）公布后上升，有助于判断「义勇军」是否出手。
businessTips.exampleEn: Today the U.S. 10-year yield is above 5% and Goldman Sachs is urging governments to cut spending as Treasurys and French bonds sell off. For investors, rising yields from fiscal fears tend to hurt long-duration assets like growth stocks and long bonds, while short-term bonds and cash become more attractive.
businessTips.exampleZh: 眼下美国10年期国债收益率超过5%，高盛呼吁各国政府削减开支，美债和法债都遭抛售。对投资者而言，财政担忧推高的收益率往往打压成长股、长期债券等长久期资产，而短期债券和现金的吸引力则会上升。
